title: Dependency advisory exceptions
objective: Remove or re-review the two temporary advisory exceptions before they expire.
context_summary: The dependency audit tolerates two maintenance advisories in the pinned Iced and Metal stacks, each with a UTC expiry and an open task here. The audit fails when an exception expires or its task is retired.

tasks.description: Remove or re-review the temporary ttf-parser maintenance exception before 2026-10-19.
extra_context: Expires exclusively on 2026-10-19; UTC expiry is enforced by the audit wrapper. Review sooner for new security information, distribution or font-input scope changes.

context_links.label: Advisory review and enforcement
context_links.relevance: Records exposure, upstream constraints and expiry.

acceptance_criteria: Check supported upstream releases and remove ttf-parser when a compatible migration is available.
Remove the exception when no longer needed; otherwise document a new bounded review with current evidence before expiry.
Run policy tests, dependency audit and relevant build/render checks after dependency changes.

steps: Inspect current upstream releases and exact configured dependency graph.
Verify expiry, audit and relevant runtime checks.
expected_results: No stale, permanent or broad advisory suppression remains.
